grade_lead.message: Measures the centering of a raw Pokémon, Lorcana, One Piece or other standard-size card from a photo and shows the highest grade it allows at PSA, BGS and CGC.

grade_err_too_large.message: This image is too large (over 15 MB or 40 megapixels).

grade_err_invalid.message: This isn't an image CertScanner can read.

grade_err_fetch.message: Couldn't get this photo from the page. Save it and drop it here.

grade_err_failed.message: Measuring failed or took too long. Try again or use a smaller photo.

grade_line_left.message: Inner edge of the left border

grade_line_right.message: Inner edge of the right border

grade_line_top.message: Inner edge of the top border

grade_line_bottom.message: Inner edge of the bottom border

grade_borders.message: Borders: left $P1$ · right $P2$ · top $P3$ · bottom $P4$ mm. Drag a red line (or select it and use the arrow keys) if it isn't on the border's inner edge.

grade_corners_hint.message: Drag the four squares onto the card's corners (or select one and use the arrow keys), then measure again.

grade_photo_alt.message: The photo, with the card's outline

grade_note_no_card.message: Couldn't find the card's edges in this photo. Place the corners by hand below.

grade_note_no_border.message: No even border found (a full-art or borderless card, or the wrong outline). Graders judge such cards by the design; CertScanner gives no number then.

grade_note_partial.message: Not every border could be measured. Drag the lines onto the borders' inner edges.

grade_note_low_res.message: The card is small in this photo ($P1$ pixels per mm): the centering is a rough guide (±$P2$ points). A larger or sharper photo helps.

grade_note_very_low_res.message: The card is very small in this photo ($P1$ pixels per mm): the centering is only a rough guide. Use a larger photo.

grade_note_blurry.message: The photo is blurry at the borders: the lines may be off a little.

grade_note_glare.message: Glare on a border: tilt the card or the light and take the photo again.

grade_note_skewed.message: Taken at an angle: straightened, but a photo from straight above measures better.

grade_note_cropped.message: The photo is cropped to the card: its edges are taken as the card's edges, so the crop affects the result.

grade_note_cut_off.message: Part of the card is outside the photo.

grade_note_manual.message: Measured with the corners you placed.

grade_note_adjusted.message: Includes lines you moved by hand.

grade_cap_possible.message: $P1$ possible: the centering is right at the limit

grade_reason_centering_back.message: The back's centering allows up to $P1$.

grade_reason_unassessed.message: Not judged from the photo: $P1$. The range is wider.

grade_note_front_only.message: Back not measured: a PSA 10 also needs about 75/25 or better on the back.

grade_note_centering_only.message: Centering only: corners, edges and surface decide the rest of the grade.

grade_ai_off.message: Not checked. A photo shows these only partly; an AI check with your own key can estimate them. Off by default: then nothing leaves this device.

grade_ai_no_key.message: Add your $P1$ key in Settings to check corners, edges and surface.

grade_ai_sends_front.message: Sends the straightened front photo to $P1$, with your key.

grade_ai_sends_both.message: Sends the straightened front and back photos to $P1$, with your key.

grade_ai_err_no_permission.message: CertScanner doesn't have access to $P1$ yet. Save your key again in Settings.

grade_ai_err_auth.message: $P1$ didn't accept your key. Check it in Settings.

grade_ai_err_forbidden.message: Your $P1$ key isn't allowed to do this check.

grade_ai_err_limit.message: Your $P1$ limit or credit is used up. Try again later or check your account.

grade_ai_err_too_large.message: The photo was too large for $P1$.

grade_ai_err_overloaded.message: $P1$ is busy right now. Try again in a minute.

grade_ai_err_format.message: $P1$ sent an answer CertScanner couldn't read.

grade_ai_err_error.message: The check with $P1$ failed. Check your connection and try again.

grade_consent_not.message: Not sent: the page address, file name, location or other photo data.

grade_consent_terms.message: $P1$'s own terms and privacy policy apply, and the check is charged to your account with them.

grade_consent_ximilar.message: Ximilar returns images of its analysis that it hosts for a while.

grade_disclaimer.message: An estimate, not a grade. Graders also judge by eye, and photos hide much of a card's condition. CertScanner is not affiliated with or endorsed by PSA, Beckett (BGS), CGC or any grading company.
